question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Certain to happen
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Inevitable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the correct answer:-
 
• **Inevitable **- certain to happen; unavoidable. (निश्चित रूप से होना; अपरिहार्य)
 
 
• For Example - Jessi drew out the **inevitable **by taking her
